name: OK! Dinner!
source:
A spin-off of the OKaverse. Covers the four main characters, with the action taking place about five days after the opening of "OTChi Kocchi."

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23711]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
這是《OKaverse》的衍生作品，講述四名主要角色的故事，時間點在《OTChi Kocchi》開場約五天之後。
